title: Claude Code v2.1.85–v2.1.90 Minor Feature Batch
description: Batch of smaller CLI/UX features from v2.1.85–v2.1.90 not yet in registry: (1) /teleport and /remote-env slash commands for cross-device session bridging between web and CLI; (2) Ctrl+B now backgrounds both bash commands AND agents simultaneously; (3) ExitWorktree built-in tool completing the EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree pair; (4) claude -n flag for naming sessions at start for easier --resume identification; (5) /plan now accepts inline description argument to enter plan mode with context in one step; (6) CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON env var to abort all scheduled cron jobs mid-session; (7) MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true for -p mode to skip MCP connection wait [ALREADY IN INTEGRATION]; (8) Named subagents appear in @ mention typeahead; (9) /powerup command for interactive feature tutorials [ALREADY FILED SEPARATELY]; (10) /copy 'w' key to write selection to file (bypasses clipboard, useful over SSH).
redundancy_notes: MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING=true is already in pipeline/integration/mcp-connection-nonblocking.md. /powerup is filed as a separate discovery (powerup-command.md). The remaining 8 features (/teleport, /remote-env, Ctrl+B agent backgrounding, ExitWorktree, claude -n, /plan description, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON, named subagents typeahead, /copy w) are NOVEL — not in registry.
high_priority_items: claude -n session naming — enables reliable --resume in heartbeat pipeline
CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON — critical for debugging cron-triggered automation
ExitWorktree built-in — completes the EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree pair
/teleport + /remote-env — cross-device session bridging (Tailscale setup is relevant)

evaluation.reasoning: Official Anthropic batch from v2.1.85-v2.1.90. High capability expansion (80) for the novel subset: ExitWorktree completes the worktree built-in tool pair (significant gap fixed); claude -n session naming directly enables reliable --resume identification in heartbeat and automation pipelines; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON fills a debugging gap for the cron-heavy workspace (heartbeat, orchestrator, openclaw-exchange all run on cron); /teleport+/remote-env enables cross-device session bridging relevant to requiem↔orbis-1 topology. Integration complexity 75: mostly built-in commands requiring only registry documentation, but claude -n and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON may need wiring into existing scripts. Token efficiency 60: MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING already captured; /copy w has minor SSH workflow value. Integration action: register all 8 novel items in registry; wire claude -n into heartbeat -p invocations for session traceability; add CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON note to cron troubleshooting docs.
